newsitem.title: USA: Wells Fargo to open banks at Lucky.
newsitem.headline: Wells Fargo to open banks at Lucky.

text.p: Wells Fargo and Co and Lucky Stores on Thursday announced a partnership that will open 24 new bank locations inside Las Vegas-area Lucky Stores.
Wells Fargo will begin installing the banking centres this month, the company said.
Shoppers can open accounts, withdraw cash from automated teller machines, make deposits, pay bills, and meet with a bank officer during peak business hours, the bank said.
Branches will be open and staffed seven days a week.
The bank, with over 1,900 staffed locations in 10 western states, is the eighth-biggest bank holding company in the U.S. with assets of $109 billion.
Lucky Stores, a subsidiary of Salt Lake City-based American Stores Co, operates 247 stores in southern California and Nevada.
The company operates 22 stores in the Las Vegas area.
